page.layout: One title page, with a woodcut below the title block and the imprint under the woodcut. A handwritten dedication in brown ink sits at the foot and is not transcribed. Nothing else is printed.

l.i: ACCESSERUNT praeterea Indices duo locupletiss. Rerum scilicet & verborum:
Locorum item sacrae scripturae, qui in hoc libro syncerissimè explicantur.

main_text.l: Abfit mihi gloriari nisi in cruce domini nostri Iesu Christi: per quem
mihi mundus crucifixus est, & ego mundo.

page.notes: Woodcut (tree with figures, vine, animals) between the title block and the imprint, not transcribed. Handwritten dedication in brown ink at the foot of the page (not printed text, so omitted): "Clarissimo Viro D. Rodolpho Gualtero ecclesiae Tigurinae ministro fideliss. ac multiplici consanguineo ... Petr. Martyr D. D." Spelling of the printed title kept as printed, including "Vermilij", "Tigurina", and the line-end hyphens.
